workflows.name: Write a pre-call account brief from SEC EDGAR and Wikipedia
steps: In the EDGAR tab, click the company search box, type {ticker} and pick {company} from the suggestions
On the company's filings page, filter the form type to 10-K
Note the filing date and period of the latest 10-K
Switch to the Wikipedia tab, search "{company}" and open the company article
From the infobox, note the headquarters, number of employees and CEO
Switch to the Mail tab, click To and type {manager}@example.com, click Subject and type "Account brief: {company} ({ticker})"
Click Body and type "{company}: HQ <city>, <employees> employees, CEO <name>. Latest 10-K filed <date>." Do not click Send. Click Discard

workflows.name: Convert two supplier quotes to USD and check the supplier's local time
steps: In the xe.com tab, set Amount and From to {quote_a}, set To to USD, click Convert and read the result
Change Amount and From to {quote_b} (To stays USD) and read the result
Switch to the timeanddate tab, search "{supplier_city}" with the site's search and open its current local time
Switch to the Mail tab, click To and type procurement@example.com, click Subject and type "Quotes: {item}"
Click Body and type "{quote_a} = <USD> USD, {quote_b} = <USD> USD, cheaper: <which>. Supplier time in {supplier_city}: <time>."
Do not click Send. Click Discard

workflows.name: Plan a cross-timezone sync around public holidays
steps: In the timeanddate tab, open the Time Zones menu and pick Time Zone Converter
Add {hq_city} and {remote_city} and note the time difference
Open the Holidays menu, pick holidays for {country}, and note the public holidays in {month}
Switch to the Mail tab, click To and type ops@example.com, click Subject and type "Sync: {hq_city} / {remote_city}, {month}"
Click Body and type "{remote_city} is <offset> from {hq_city}. Avoid: <holiday dates>."
Do not click Send. Click Discard

noise.description: Open a new tab, go to bbc.com/news, scroll through the headlines, open one story, skim it, close the tab
In the Wikipedia tab, click Random article in the menu, skim it and scroll a bit
Abandoned attempt: in the xe.com tab, type 50 in Amount and start setting From to CHF, then give up halfway and switch to the Wikipedia tab
Wander: click through the Notes, Mail and EDGAR tabs without doing anything
